stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig is working on her computer while Peppa and George watch
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Story/Work): 'What is Mummy Pig doing on her computer?' (Prompt: Working / Playing games) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'She is working on her computer!'
Q2 (Desire): 'George is standing here. What game does he want to play?' (Prompt: Happy Mrs Chicken / Car game) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Happy Mrs Chicken!'
Q3 (Observation): 'Look behind Mummy Pig! What green plant is sitting on the blue cabinet?' (Prompt: A green cactus / A flower) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'It's a cactus!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa and Suzy play shops at playgroup with a toy till
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Pretend Play): 'What pretend game are Peppa and Suzy playing?' (Prompt: Playing shops / Playing doctor) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'They are playing shops!'
Q2 (Role): 'Peppa is standing by the yellow cash register. What is her job?' (Prompt: Shopkeeper / Customer) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'She is the shopkeeper!'
Q3 (Observation): 'Look at the green shelf! Can you spot the yellow rubber duck?' (Prompt: Yes / No) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Yes, on the shelf!'

stopPoints.label: Rebecca Rabbit comes into the shop to buy a carrot
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Character/Food): 'Rebecca Rabbit is the customer! What yummy vegetable does she want to buy?' (Prompt: A carrot / An apple) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'She wants to buy a carrot!'
Q2 (Item/Number): 'Look at the cash register! Does it have numbers on top?' (Prompt: Yes, numbers / No) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Yes, lots of numbers!'
Q3 (Humor): 'How much does the carrot cost in their silly game?' (Prompt: A million pounds / One coin) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'A million thousand pounds!'

stopPoints.label: Everyone plays Happy Mrs Chicken together and falls down laughing
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Outcome): 'Mummy and Daddy finished their work! What game are they all playing now?' (Prompt: Happy Mrs Chicken / Football) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Happy Mrs Chicken!'
Q2 (Action/Emotion): 'Look at everyone lying on the floor! Why are they laughing?' (Prompt: They are very happy / They are crying) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'They are laughing and having fun!'
Q3 (Who): 'Who is wearing glasses and rolling on his back?' (Prompt: Daddy Pig / George) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Daddy Pig!'
